summary: Manila 3rd District representative with 91 principal-authored bills. Authored estate tax amnesty extension, presidential power to suspend fuel excise, solar-equipment tax exemption and a higher income-tax exemption ceiling; co-authored the national minimum wage, teacher and government pay increases, gig-worker protection and a plastic-bag excise.
caveat: Economic evidence only. Tax and labor items point in opposite directions; the -1 reflects that mix. Co-authorship does not prove endorsement of each provision.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored tax relief and incentives (estate tax amnesty, fuel-excise suspension, solar exemption: +1 net) against co-authored minimum wage and gig-worker protection (-2) and higher public-sector pay (-2).
